block-guide:
CORE/QUOTE A quotation with an optional source line. Its text is ordinary blocks inside it (paragraphs, lists, headings), so it can hold several paragraphs. A short eye-catching line pulled from the page's own text: core/pullquote. MARKUP (checked in the editor)

Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.

Leonardo da Vinci

Superb product and customer service!

We would order again.

Jo Smith, Example Ltd.
The inner blocks are full blocks with their own comments; text is never bare inside
. comes last, right after the last inner block's closing comment; no citation = no . Inner blocks are separated by a blank line. OPTIONS Text alignment is the "textAlign" attribute here -> class has-text-align- right after wp-block-quote (not style.typography.textAlign as on headings and pullquotes). Styles: "default" (no class) and "plain" (is-style-plain: no side border, no padding). There is no "large" style in this WordPress version. align: left|right|wide|full only (no center). CHECK Reopen the editor: no "unexpected or invalid content" notice; the front shows the quote with its source line.
